.github/workflows/
│
├── release.yml                 ← master trigger, runs on tag push
│
├── build-core.yml              ← optional prebuild step (shared artifacts)
│
├── deploy-deb.yml              ← Debian/Ubuntu (APT repo)
├── deploy-rpm.yml              ← RedHat/Fedora (.rpm)
├── deploy-brew.yml             ← macOS / Homebrew
└── deploy-choco.yml            ← Windows / Chocolatey
